phase.hormonalSummary: Progesterone and estrogen fall if no pregnancy occurs, which leads to a period. Premenstrual symptoms often show up around this time.
phase.whatToTrack: Cramps, sleep quality, irritability, backache, and spotting.
phase.primaryArticleTitle: Why Do Cramps Happen? Prostaglandins and Menstrual Pain
phase.biologicalExplainer: Progesterone and estrogen fall if no pregnancy occurs, which leads to a period. Premenstrual symptoms often show up around this time.
